name: terraform-review-medium-suite
known_facts: Idempotency means the module produces the same result on every apply
The standard module layout is main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf, versions.tf, README.md
Modules must not expose secrets and should use least-privilege IAM
Outputs should be useful for consumers, not just echo inputs
State safety means avoiding state drift and data loss
locals should be used for derived values and documented

input.module_purpose: Create VPC, subnets, routing, and network ACLs
Create resource group with consistent tagging
